name: ＳＵＮＤＡＹブレイク
overview:
‘SUNDAY Break.’ Airing on Sunday mornings—a special time marking the start of the week—the programme aims to be a live-style show that gives viewers a real sense of ‘moving towards Monday’.

‘SUNDAY Break.’ is committed to providing positive insights and tips that make the first step into tomorrow feel just a little lighter. Through news, sport, entertainment and special features, it aims to create a special moment on Sunday mornings.
